about-me.title: About me
about-me.description:
Senior Frontend Engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable digital products, design systems, and high-performance web applications. Strong background in JavaScript, PHP, Drupal and Laravel. Passionate about AI-powered automation and crafting intuitive user experiences.

Experienced in mentoring teams and collaborating across engineering, product, SEO, and business stakeholders.

Specialized in web performance (Core Web Vitals), scalable frontend architecture, scripting and automation, and technical mentoring. Full-stack capable: comfortable making decisions that cross the frontend boundary.

experience.achievement-title: Core Web Vitals Optimization — Selectra CMS · 2025–2026
experience.achievement-desc:
• Context: PageSpeed stuck at ~57/100 on key sites, dragged down by structural CLS from images without declared dimensions
  • Solution: Python script that walked the monorepo and batch-processed thousands of Blade templates, injecting width/height on every img tag; complemented with manual above-the-fold fixes
  • Prevention: Git pre-commit hook via prepare script to block regressions
  • Outcome: PageSpeed 57 → 100. Approach is replicable across the full monorepo
